artworks.title: Mary, Wife of Thomas Habingdon
artworks.description: The image shows two engraved portraits, one above the other. The top portrait is of Thomas Habingdon Esq., and the bottom portrait is of his wife, Mary Habingdon. Thomas is depicted facing forward with his shoulders slightly turned, wearing an elaborate high-ruffed collar and striped jacket. Mary is shown in a similar pose with her hands at chest level, wearing a detailed ruff, a decorated bodice, and sleeves. Both have plain backgrounds, and descriptive text about each person is placed under their image.

artworks.title: Charles Montagu, First Earl of Halifax
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a three-quarter view of the subject's body, from the waist up. The person is standing with one arm bent and resting on their hip, while the other arm is extended slightly outwards. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair, which frames their face. Their facial features include a composed expression with slightly parted lips and eyes looking directly at the viewer. The person's attire consists of an elaborate garment with a high-collared shirt featuring a cravat-type neckpiece, and a jacket adorned with decorative buttons. A cape or cloak drapes over their shoulder. The background features a natural setting with leafy trees and a slightly blurred forest scene.

artworks.title: Rev. Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man in ecclesiastical clothing. He is facing forward, holding a book in his right hand. The man has a long beard and mustache, with combed back hair under a skullcap. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with inscriptions. The frame is adorned with intricate designs, including cherubs, scrolls, a coat of arms, scientific instruments, books, and laurel leaves. The background features detailed linework on a carved stone or wood panel.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image portrays a man shown from the waist up. He has a long face with a well-defined, pointed beard and mustache. His straight hair is visible under a close-fitted cap. The man wears ornate clothing, including an intricate lace collar over a dark robe with embroidered details. He holds a book in his left hand. The image frame is ornate, with scrolls and text as decoration against a dark, textured background with Latin phrases and ecclesiastical motifs.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man seated facing forward within an oval frame. He has distinct facial features with a long beard and mustache, and is dressed in clergy attire. The man holds a small book in his right hand. The background is adorned with decorative motifs including cherubs and a coat of arms. The frame is inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man with a pointed beard, mustache, and styled hair. He has a serious expression and wears ecclesiastical attire with a ruff around his neck, lace cuffs, and a vestment over his shoulders. He holds a small book and the portrait is in an ornate oval frame with decorative patterns. Cherubs are depicted at the top corners of the frame. The background has fine lines, and the frame is inscribed with the words 'Iosephi Hall Norvic' and 'Vera Effigies Reverendio'.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.artist: Paul de Zetter after John Payne
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated with his body turned slightly to the side, but his face directed towards the viewer. The man has a long face and a prominent nose, featuring a beard that is pointed and styled downward. His hair is mostly covered by a cap, suggesting it is short. He is wearing a high-collared top with a wide, pleated ruff collar that extends outward. His clothing appears to be formal, with a richly ornamented garment featuring embroidery at the chest area. He holds a book in one hand close to his chest, and on the chest, there is a prominent medallion hanging from a ribbon. The background is ornate, set within an oval frame, with decorative elements including floral motifs and scrolls surrounding the portrait. The name "IOSEPHVS" and "EXONIENSIS" appear on the border of the oval frame. Various architectural and geometric designs also adorn the surrounding border and lower portion of the frame.

artworks.title: Christopher Harant
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man's upper body turned slightly to his right, with his head facing the viewer. He has defined facial features, short curly hair, and a confident expression. He is wearing a high ruffled collar and a suit of armor with chainmail on his arms. The background features detailed line work creating a halo effect. An inscription in Latin names the individual and his titles.

artworks.title: William Van Haren
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left while facing forward, featuring a long wavy hairstyle and distinguished facial features. He wears an elegant garment with a richly decorated, patterned collar and a large, elaborately designed cravat or neck cloth. The man is depicted within an oval frame decorated with intricate leaf motifs and linear design elements. Below the image, there is a coat of arms with a shield, crown, and Latin inscription. The background displays classical ornamental designs typical of the period.

artworks.title: John Harington, First Baron of Exton
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man facing slightly to his right, positioned within an oval frame. The man has wavy and curly gray hair, along with a mustache and neatly trimmed beard. His expression is calm as he gazes directly at the viewer. He is dressed in an ornate, high-necked garment with a lace ruff around his neck. The background is plain, and the engraving is on aged paper with printed text below the portrait and an artist's signature within the oval.

artworks.title: John Harington, First Baron of Exton
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's upper body, depicted in a formal seated or standing position. His head is slightly turned towards his right, looking directly at the viewer. He has a distinguished facial structure with a well-groomed mustache and beard. His hair appears curly and neatly styled, slightly receding at the temples. He wears an elaborate outfit adorned with a high, lace ruff collar and a patterned garment that suggests formality and status. Encircling his portrait is an oval frame with inscriptions. No jewelry is visible, and he is not holding any objects. The background is filled with intricate line work, typical of an engraving, and the frame includes additional text and decorative elements outside of the oval.

artworks.title: John Harington, Second Baron of Exton
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper half of a man facing slightly to the side. He has delicate features, including prominent cheekbones and expressive eyes. His hair is styled short and neat, framing his face. He wears a richly embroidered doublet with a large ruffled collar, typical of the late Renaissance period. The ornate frame surrounding the image features detailed scrollwork, mythical creatures, and emblematic symbols. Decorative elements like a lion's head and a bird-like creature are in the corners. The background contains Gothic-style text that likely adds context or praise. The overall style is formal, emphasizing the subject's status and significance.

artworks.title: John Harington, Second Baron of Exton
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with distinct facial features. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but looking at the viewer, displaying his upper body, including his shoulders and head. The man has fair complexion, arched eyebrows, and a long, pointed nose. His medium-length, wavy hair is styled upwards. He is dressed in a ruffled collar typical of the period and a buttoned-up garment with a high neckline. The oval frame around the portrait includes text that reads "IOHANNES Haringtonus Baro de Exton." The background has detailed lines for texture, and there is additional text in a classical typeface below the image within the frame. The portrait is set against an off-white paper background, hinting at it being a historical print or illustration.

artworks.title: John Harington, Second Baron of Exton
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust view of a person in an oval frame. The person is facing forward with the head slightly turned to the right in a three-quarter profile. The facial features are sharp and well-defined with a serious expression. The hair is styled up and back. The individual wears period clothing with a high lace ruff around the neck and a buttoned garment with intricate details. An earring is visible in the left ear. The background has a dark gradient with fine lines, contrasting with the light oval frame highlighting the figure. Text is present around the oval and below the frame.

artworks.title: John, Lord Harrington of Exton
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a portrait featuring a person's upper body. The figure faces the viewer's left in a straight, slight three-quarter position. They have refined eyes, a slightly smiling mouth, and elegant hair styled away from the face. The person wears dark attire with a high, ruffled collar. The oval frame around the portrait likely identifies the person, and below it, there is an inscription resembling a poem on a textured background.

artworks.title: James Harrington, Esq.
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. He has a composed expression with a mustache, thick curly hair, and is wearing an ornate garment with intricate embroidery and lacework on the collar. The background is minimal, with an oval matte framing the man and separating him from the darker backdrop. There is an inscription at the bottom of the image with the name James Harrington and additional printed text detailing the portrait's provenance.

artworks.title: James Harrington, Esq.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man seated and looking directly at the viewer. He has a mustache and a full head of curly, dark hair that reaches his shoulders. He is wearing a richly decorated garment with an ornate floral pattern across the shoulders and a fur-trimmed cloak. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Hartoch Christian of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image shows a series of cityscapes surrounding a central figure on a horse. The city views are depicted from a distance, showing various buildings and landscapes. The central panel features a noble figure on horseback, with a background of rolling hills and a distant townscape. The artwork is detailed with fine lines and a monochromatic color palette. The city illustrations are boxed and labeled, each displaying unique scenic details. The composition is organized with symmetry and balance.

artworks.title: Jean Baptiste Hautin
artworks.description: This print features a portrait of an older man within an ornate oval frame. The man is facing us with a slight smile. He has pale skin, a pointed white beard, a curled gray mustache, dark eyebrows, high cheekbones, wavy gray hair, and thin lips curved upward. He is wearing a dark garment with a large white collar and small buttons down the front. Around the oval portrait is a band with text, and beyond that is a frame adorned with foliage. Below the frame are two trumpet shapes pointing to the left and right, and below those are two sphinxlike figures turned to the sides. At the top of the frame are wing-like shapes and stacks of books.

artworks.title: Sir John Hawkins
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man, depicted from the torso up. He is seated and slightly angled to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a sharp facial structure with prominent cheekbones, a pointed beard, and a mustache. His hair is mostly hidden under a tall, rounded hat with a band design. The man is wearing an elaborate period costume with a ruffled collar and a doublet adorned with buttons. His right hand is partially visible, holding a roll of paper or similar object. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame, surrounded by the text "IOANNES HAWKINS". The background outside of the oval frame consists of closely spaced horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Sir John Hawkins
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man seen from the mid-torso up. He is posed in a three-quarters view, slightly turned to his right. The man has a distinct facial expression, with a finely arched mustache and full beard. He wears a hat adorned with a patterned band, a high-collared garment with a large ruff around his neck, and holds a staff or rod in his left hand. The portrait is in black and white, framed by an oval with the inscription "IOANNES HAWKINS" around the edge. The background features cross-hatched lines for visual depth, with Latin text beneath the oval.

artworks.title: Sir John Hawkins, Naval Commander
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his body slightly facing to the right and his head turned towards the viewer. He has a distinguished facial appearance with a mustache and beard, wearing a hat with decorative elements. He is dressed in a detailed tunic with padded areas and a high ruffled collar, holding a long cylindrical object. In the background, there is a nautical scene with sailing ships on the water. Above his right shoulder is an elaborate coat of arms with decorative scrollwork and the text "ADVANCMENT BY DILLIGE." Below the portrait, the name "Sr John Hankins Knight" is inscribed.

artworks.title: Sir John Hawkins, Naval Commander
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of Sir John Hawkins, depicted from the upper half. He is facing slightly left but looking straight ahead, holding a stick or cane with his right arm across his chest. His features include a beard, mustache, short hair, and a hat or helmet with an embellished band. He wears an intricate garment with a ruffed collar, layered sleeves, decorative armor, buttons, and a bracelet. The background shows water, sailing ships, and a cloudy sky. A crest with a lion and dragon-like figures is in the top right corner. The inscription below honors Sir John Hawkins, Knight.

artworks.title: Johan Ludovicus Hawenrenter
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraving of an upper-body portrait of a man standing. He has a prominent forehead, a full beard, and short, thinning hair. The man is wearing a collared garment, possibly fine fabric, with a cape, and a ruffled collar. He holds a walking stick or staff. The background consists of parallel lines. Text and a border surround the image, likely providing information about the depicted individual.
